## 00f0de29a65c

The `texture="plain"` contract does not actually exclude the `size_tie` curriculum branch. Reproduction from `checks/audit-repro.log`: `generate(3, 0, texture="plain", n_shapes=3)` yields multi-component sizes `[3, 3, 4]`, so the “plain” texture contains a minimum-size tie. This makes the texture label unreliable for downstream stratification.

A second concrete axis failure is visible in the same probe: `generate(1, 0, difficulty="easy", n_shapes=4)` returns only two multi-cell shapes (`[6, 7]`) because the easy branch fixes `n_shapes = 2` and ignores the advertised override. The generator should route helpful texture and shape-count choices through keyed draws and verify realized counts.
